title: Caffein
description: A chill, vanilla+, not-so balanced modpack for optimization, QoL features and customizable UI stuff! Only for 1.21
body:
# **Welcome To Caffein!** 

_This modpack is a compilation of all QoL, performance and other features that I personally
love to be having during my playtroughs!_
---
Also, it's worth mentioning it has some speedrunning features such as **hiding your hands** or **easy smithing templates** for netherite.

---

It also has a shader installed called **Rudimentary** making your game look like a
ps1/psx game with vortex collapsing and low res rendering!

---

Another cool mod is probably **health bar** showing you mobs' health in a cool way!

---

**AND THAT'S NOT ALL, BUT EVERY OTHER MOD WILL BE HERE WHEN I'M DONE COMPILING THE v1 VERSION OF THE MOD PACK!!!**

---

_For Now Though, You Can Play The **BETA** Version Of It!_
